timeline.label: 10 April 1912
timeline.text: Leaves Southampton on its maiden voyage

timeline.label: 14 April, 11.40 pm
timeline.text: Hits an iceberg in the North Atlantic

questions.q: Put in order: Carpathia arrives, hits iceberg, leaves Southampton, sinks.
questions.a: Leaves Southampton, hits iceberg, sinks, Carpathia arrives
questions.model: Start of the voyage: leaves Southampton. Then the accident: hits iceberg. Then: sinks. Last: rescue by the Carpathia.

questions.q: Give one cause of the high death toll.
Give one change made after the disaster.
questions.a: Lifeboat places for everyone on board

questions.q: Core: Make a timeline of the Titanic's voyage with four dated events.
questions.a: 10 April leaves Southampton; 14 April 11.40 pm hits iceberg; 15 April about 2.20 am sinks; 15 April rescue by the Carpathia
questions.model: Teacher shows it first: 10 April 1912, left Southampton on its first voyage.

questions.q: Extend: Write a paragraph: could the disaster have been prevented? Use the portal response box.
questions.a: For example: Yes, partly: slowing down, acting on ice warnings and carrying enough lifeboats would have saved many lives

questions.q: Stretch: Which cause was most important? Explain.
questions.a: Reasoned answer, for example: too few lifeboats, because it decided how many could survive

questions.q: Big question: could the Titanic disaster have been prevented?
questions.a: Partly: by slowing down, acting on ice warnings and carrying enough lifeboats
